note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 26 November 2026, RealHunt lists 88 homes for sale in Italy, each one checked by a person.
In Italy, the median asking price of those 88 homes is €85,000 (€1,000 per m², from the 69 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €12,000 and the most expensive €197,000.
Taxes and fees add about 4–15% to the price of a home in Italy (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Registration tax 9% on a second home (resale), or VAT on new builds; notary 1-2% + legal ~1% + agent ~3% (GPG roundtrip 10-18%).
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes for EU citizens; non-EU buyers need reciprocity (US, UK, Canada, Australia qualify).
buying.annual_property_tax: IMU 0.4-1.06% on second homes (on cadastral value).
buying.rental_income_tax: Optional flat 'cedolare secca' on short lets: 21% for one property, 26% from the second.

Sea-facing, sleeps up to 4, sold with fridge-freezer and washing machine. About 15 minutes from Lamezia Terme international airport. Asking €28,000.

Balcony and rooftops with a sweeping view down to the sea and the coast towards Cefalù; the nearest beach is about 15 minutes away. Good condition, sold privately. Asking €30,000.

homes.title: Renovated stone house with a lake-view balcony above Lake Como
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra reformada con balcón con vistas al lago de Como
homes.summary: A semi-detached stone house in a quiet old village in San Siro, on the western shore of Lake Como near Menaggio, renovated a few years ago and sold fully furnished. Ground floor: living room with a fireplace and a separate kitchen. Upstairs: two bedrooms, one opening onto a small balcony with open views over the lake and the mountains, and a bathroom with a tub. Small private courtyard, public parking a short walk away, south-east facing, gas heating. The price was cut from €130,000 to €95,000 (-27%). The lake is about 5 minutes away; Lugano Airport about 40 minutes and Milan Malpensa about 1 h 10. At about €1,580/m² it is roughly 40% below the San Siro average for houses (€2,690/m², RealAdvisor, Oct 2026).

homes.title: Furnished lake-view house in the old centre of San Siro, Lake Como
homes.title_es: Casa amueblada con vistas al lago en el casco antiguo de San Siro, lago de Como
homes.summary: An 85 m² restored, habitable semi-detached house in the car-free historic centre of San Siro, on the west shore of Lake Como. Two floors plus a mezzanine: entrance hall, bedroom and shower room downstairs; a bright living room with fireplace and wooden beams and a separate kitchen upstairs; an attic bedroom with two Velux windows. Lake views from the living floor and the mezzanine. Sold fully furnished, with a separate cellar. Asking €115,000, about €1,353/m².

Asking €195,000, about €2,438/m².

Downstairs a large kitchen and dining room opens onto a private garden of about 100 m² with fruit trees. Upstairs are two bedrooms, a modern bathroom and a balcony with a wide view over the valley. A separate 24 m² cellar is included. It has double glazing, its own gas heating and mains services, and the advert calls it ready to move into. The village has a bar, grocery and pharmacy. Asking €55,000, under €600 per m².

About 180 m2 with a dining room and open kitchen, TV room, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, plus a tavern with fireplace, two cellars and a garage. Wood stoves, no central heating. Described as in excellent condition and ready to move in, at roughly 640 euros per m2.

homes.place: San Lorenzo in Campo, Le Marche
homes.summary: An early 1900s detached house in the centre of San Lorenzo in Campo, a hill village in Pesaro and Urbino province, about 25 km from the Marotta beaches. The renovated, furnished first floor (65 m2) has a kitchen with dining area, two bedrooms and a bathroom; the ground floor (65 m2) holds a garage and two storage rooms. The owner lists wall and ceiling insulation, new floors, exterior painting and certified wiring, plumbing and boiler. A fenced south-facing garden of about 350 m2, a covered pergola and a carport. Pharmacy, shops and schools are a short walk away.

homes.title: Medieval-village house with a terrace above a sea of clouds in Tuscany

New heating (LPG, pellet and wood). Lucca, Pisa and Florence are within reach. Asking €150,000, about €1,014/m².

A large terrace of about 70 m² and a big garage. The Tuscan sea is about 40 minutes away. Asking €158,000, about €718/m².

homes.title_es: Casa costera de tres dormitorios con patio pavimentado en Torremezzo di Falconara, Calabria

The advert gives its condition as excellent: four rooms on the ground floor with a separate fitted kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. Outside there is a covered veranda with room for a table and armchairs, a large paved courtyard with a garden corner, and a bedroom annex with a timber ceiling. The photos show it furnished and well kept, with tiled floors and wooden shutters. Asking €85,000, about €840/m². Energy class G.

homes.title: Renovated country house with garden and vineyard views near Acqui Terme
homes.title_es: Casa de campo renovada con jardín y vistas a viñedos cerca de Acqui Terme
homes.summary: A large house about 2 km from the spa town of Acqui Terme, free on three sides and largely renovated according to the advert. About 200 m2 on two floors: entrance hall, living room, kitchen with a French window to the private garden and a dining room under a brick vault on the ground floor, with bedrooms, a bathroom, a laundry and a balcony with open views upstairs. The photos show a paved garden terrace and vineyards behind. Independent gas central heating, a fireplace and parking space. Around 900 euros per m2 for a move-in home in the Monferrato wine hills.

The feel of a country home wrapped into an easy-to-enjoy village setting.

homes.title: Four-bedroom village house with a guest flat and covered terrace in Secinaro, Abruzzo
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de cuatro dormitorios con piso de huéspedes y terraza cubierta en Secinaro, Abruzzo
homes.summary: A large house in the mountain village of Secinaro, made by joining three small flats, 171 m² in all. One part still works as a separate guest flat with its own living room, kitchen, bathroom and a bedroom with a balcony. The main home has vaulted ceilings, a kitchen with a dining room, a living room with a fireplace, further bedrooms and bathrooms, and balconies looking over the valley. A covered terrace at the entrance faces the village and the mountains. Furnished and lived in, with several entrances. The Sirente-Velino park starts at the edge of the village. Asking €95,000, about €555/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with a fireplace in the Monte Amiata woods at Selva, Santa Fiora
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada con chimenea en los bosques de Monte Amiata en Selva, Santa Fiora
homes.summary: An old stone house with its own entrance in Selva, a small hamlet of Santa Fiora at about 750 m in the chestnut and beech woods of Monte Amiata in southern Tuscany. It has been fully redone, with a new hydro-pellet heating system, new bathrooms, new wiring and new windows. About 120 m² on three levels: a cellar and garage on the ground floor, then a large kitchen under timber beams, a living room with a fireplace, two double bedrooms and a bathroom, and a third attic bedroom with a small bathroom on top. A plot of about 1,000 m² close by can be used for parking and a garden.

homes.title: Two-bedroom apartment with terrace in a historic Tuscan village
homes.title_es: Piso de dos dormitorios con terraza en un pueblo histórico toscano
homes.summary: Charming 2-bedroom apartment in the historic Tuscan village of Montieri. 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, 51 m² (549 sq ft). Set along a charming alley leading toward the historic castle square, the apartment has a comfortable living room, a kitchenette, two bedrooms and a private terrace with attractive views.

homes.title: Village cottage with a private garden and a hill-view balcony in Loazzolo, Piedmont
homes.title_es: Cabaña de pueblo con jardín privado y balcón con vista a la colina en Loazzolo, Piamonte
homes.summary: A cottage in the centre of Loazzolo, a hill village near Asti, steps from the main square. It is reached through a cobbled alley and a stone arch into a private garden with a patio for eating outside. About 87 m²: a bright open-plan living room and kitchen with French doors to the patio, then two bedrooms upstairs, one with a balcony looking over the rolling hills, and a bathroom. At street level there is a garage, a cellar and a small infernot, a traditional wine room cut into the rock. Gas central heating. Listed in good structural condition.

homes.title: Renovated stone house inside the walls of Gaglietole Castle, Umbria
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada dentro de los muros del Castillo de Gaglietole, Umbría
homes.summary: A stone house within the walls of the small medieval castle of Gaglietole, near Collazzone in the hills between Perugia and Todi, recently renovated and described as in excellent condition. About 125 m2: a large living area, an eat-in kitchen with a wood-burning stove, a double and a single bedroom, a study area and two bathrooms, plus an attic reached by a pull-down stair. The bedroom windows look over open hills. A single garage nearby is included. Roughly 1,000 euros per m2 for a move-in home in a historic Umbrian setting, a few minutes from shops and services.

homes.title: Renovated 1790 townhouse with garden and hill views in Ruota, near Lucca
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 1790 renovada con jardín y vistas a las colinas en Ruota, cerca de Lucca
homes.summary: A detached stone townhouse from 1790 in the small hill village of Ruota, completely renovated in 2015, with views over the hills and the Compitese plain. About 95 m2 on three floors: open kitchen and living room with a big fireplace, then a double and a twin bedroom, a study corner and a shower room with skylight, and a cellar room with a rock wall that opens onto the enclosed private garden. No condominium fees, an owned parking space in front of the garden, and papers in order according to the advert. Lucca is 20 to 30 minutes away and Pisa airport about 45.

homes.title: Renovated period flat with vaulted ceilings in central Acqui Terme, Piedmont
homes.title_es: Piso de época renovado con techos abovedados en el centro de Acqui Terme, Piamonte
homes.summary: A second-floor flat of about 120 m2 in a period building in the centre of Acqui Terme, the Piedmont spa town known for its hot springs and wine country. The advert says it was completely renovated, keeping the vaulted ceilings and original marble fireplace, with new wooden floors throughout. Living room and kitchen divided by a corten steel wall, a large bedroom, a second connected bedroom or study, and a bathroom with tub. Three balconies, two over the street and one inside the courtyard. Independent gas heating. No lift, so stairs only. About 1,170 euros per m2.

homes.title: Cosy mountain townhouse near the Abetone ski slopes, sold furnished
homes.title_es: Casa de montaña acogedora junto a las pistas de Abetone, se vende amueblada
homes.summary: A 127 m² terraced house free on three sides in the centre of Cutigliano, a few kilometres from the ski slopes of Doganaccia and Abetone: a large beamed living room with a fireplace and parquet, a kitchen with a wood-fired grill, a utility room, three bedrooms and a bathroom, plus a partly usable attic. In very good condition, with efficient systems, and sold furnished. Price negotiable. Asking €159,000, about €1,252/m².

homes.title_es: 'La Casa Felice': casa de 2 dormitorios en un pueblo de colina de Umbría por 48.000 €
homes.summary: A two-level terraced home of about 77 m² in the heart of San Venanzo, a hilltop village in Umbria, with two bedrooms, a living room with a wood stove and a fitted kitchen. Shops and services are a short walk away, Orvieto is half an hour by car.

homes.title_es: Casa de piedra en un pueblo medieval toscano
homes.summary: Stone house for €45,000 in Tuscany, Italy 65 m² · 2 beds · 1 bath · cellar · medieval village

homes.title: Rustic stone house with courtyard, balcony and several outbuildings
homes.title_es: Casa rústica de piedra con patio, balcón y varias dependencias anexas
homes.summary: Full of rustic charm, this traditional stone home in Colfelice, Frosinone, features a cozy fireplace, generous rooms and a lovely balcony overlooking the surrounding landscape. A private courtyard and several useful outbuildings add plenty of space and potential, whether for storage, a workshop or future projects.

homes.title: Beamed stone duplex with a lake-view garden and garage above Lake Iseo, Parzanica
homes.title_es: Dúplex de piedra con vigas y jardín con vistas al lago y garaje encima del lago Iseo, Parzanica
homes.summary: A two-storey flat of 80 m² in the stone village of Parzanica, 750 metres up and, according to the advert, a ten-minute drive from Lake Iseo. The ground floor has a living room under exposed beams, an eat-in kitchen with a fireplace and a guest toilet. A timber staircase leads to a double bedroom and a shower room below a pitched wooden ceiling. A small private garden looks straight down on the lake and Monte Isola, and a single garage is included. Built in 2000, energy class G. Asking €100,000 after a price cut of about 17%.

homes.title: Bright three-floor house with terraces facing Lake Omodeo in Soddì, Sardinia
homes.title_es: Casa luminosa de tres plantas con terrazas frente al lago Omodeo en Soddì, Cerdeña
homes.summary: A large, light house in Soddì, a village of about 100 people in central Sardinia, facing Lake Omodeo. About 150 m2 on three floors: hall, kitchen, living room and bathroom at entry level, a main bedroom with a lake-view balcony, two smaller bedrooms and a second bathroom upstairs, and two cellar rooms below, one set up with sofas, a fireplace and a pizza oven. Two terraces, two air conditioning units, and the advert states the roof is in perfect condition with no leaks and the paperwork in order. The rear terrace needs a refresh.

homes.title: Sea-view villa with two covered verandas 1 km from Vignola beach
homes.title_es: Villa con vistas al mar y dos verandas cubiertas a 1 km de la playa de Vignola
homes.summary: An end-of-terrace villa in the Baia Vignola residential complex in north Sardinia, with a splendid sea view: a bright living room with a kitchenette, a master bedroom, a second small bedroom and a shower room, plus two large covered verandas, one facing the sea for lunches and dinners in the breeze, and a private garden. Parking space in the complex. The village of Vignola Mare and its crystal-clear beaches are 1 km away. Asking €160,000, about €1,860/m².

homes.title: Renovated Umbrian country home with an annexe, vines and an orchard
homes.title_es: Casa de campo reformada en Umbría con anexo, parra y huerto de frutales
homes.summary: A finely renovated 90 m² home over three floors in the small Valdilucciole hamlet near Città della Pieve, plus a 24 m² annexe with a living/sleeping area: beamed ceilings, a living room with a pellet stove, a kitchen, two bathrooms and three bedrooms with countryside views. A fenced garden and orchard with olive, peach, pear, fig and plum trees and a row of table grapes. New roof in 2015 and double-glazed wooden windows. Asking €160,000, about €1,404/m².

homes.title: Renovated country house with panoramic porch and olive grove near Arpino, Lazio
homes.title_es: Casa de campo renovada con porche panorámico y olival cerca de Arpino, Lazio
homes.summary: A recently renovated single-storey country house on the hills around Arpino, within walking distance of the historic town. The photos show new bathrooms, white walls, wood floors and a large covered porch with a beamed wooden roof looking over olive trees and mountains. It has a fireplace, a pellet stove, air conditioning, new double glazing and metal shutters, plus a cellar. The garden around the house is fenced and gated, and the plot of about 11,751 m2 is planted with olives. About 147 m2 for 180,000 euros, under 1,250 euros per m2.

homes.summary: 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, 51 m² (549 sq ft). Small, colorful and full of personality, this apartment makes the most of its compact footprint with a spacious living room, dining area, kitchenette and a handy attic.

homes.title: Move-in-ready alpine chalet at 1,000 m with private land
homes.title_es: Chalet alpino listo para entrar a vivir a 1.000 m con terreno propio
homes.summary: Independent chalet with private land and panoramic terrace at Via Ponte Vecchio, Paesana, Cuneo, Piedmont. About 30 m² of open-plan living space, 1 bathroom, approx. 600-650 m² of private land and a 20 m² panoramic terrace. Parking for up to 2 cars nearby, paved road access, at about 1,000 m altitude.

homes.title: Fully renovated, fully furnished stone home in a quiet Tuscan village
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra totalmente reformada y amueblada en un pueblo toscano tranquilo
homes.summary: Beautifully renovated and tucked into a quiet Tuscan village in Subbiano, Arezzo, this cozy stone home combines rustic character with bright, modern interiors and comes fully furnished. With nothing left to renovate, it is an easy little escape for anyone dreaming of slower days and authentic Italian village life.

homes.title: Renovated, furnished stone home with mezzanine and private garden in Tuscany
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra reformada y amueblada con altillo y jardín privado en la Toscana
homes.place: Castelnuovo di Val di Cecina, Pisa, Tuscany, Italy
homes.summary: Beautifully renovated and full of rustic character, this cozy stone home in Castelnuovo di Val di Cecina pairs exposed beams and a fireplace with a charming mezzanine and its own private garden. Sold fully furnished and ready to enjoy, it is an inviting little retreat for slow escapes in the Tuscan countryside.

homes.title: Renovated granite stazzo with flower boxes in a Sardinian village
homes.title_es: Stazzo de granito reformado con flores en las ventanas en un pueblo de Cerdeña
homes.summary: A traditional Gallurese stazzo in the historic centre of Luras, northern Sardinia, restored with respect for its exposed granite, wood and iron: a living room with an open kitchen around a big fireplace, a reed-and-beam ceiling, bold colours and pop touches, a double bedroom, a second bedroom, two bathrooms and an attic. Flower boxes on the stone façade, and the Costa Smeralda beaches about 40 minutes away. Asking €97,000, about €1,386/m².

homes.title: Stone townhouse with beamed rooms in the old centre of Montecatini Val di Cecina, Tuscany
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de piedra con habitaciones con vigas en el centro antiguo de Montecatini Val di Cecina, Toscana
homes.summary: A stone townhouse of about 110 m² on three levels in the medieval centre of Montecatini Val di Cecina, a hill village the advert says has all the necessary services. The first floor has a large kitchen and dining room with a big brick fireplace, a living room and a bathroom. The top floor has a double bedroom and a second room used as a study, with a view over the old roofs and lanes. The ground floor holds a laundry and a hobby room. It has city gas heating and air conditioning, and is listed in good structural condition. Asking €100,000, about €910 per m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with terrace in medieval Arcidosso, Monte Amiata
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada con terraza en Arcidosso medieval, Monte Amiata
homes.summary: A fully renovated house with its own front door in the medieval centre of Arcidosso, a lively hill town on the slopes of Monte Amiata in southern Tuscany. Inside are exposed stone walls, beamed ceilings and terracotta floors: a large living room with kitchen corner and fireplace, a study, a bathroom and a usable terrace on the lower level, then a double bedroom, a small second bedroom and a second bathroom above. Heating runs on mains gas, and it is sold furnished and ready to live in. About 100 m2 for 115,000 euros.

homes.title: Four-level town house ready to live in at Collesano, in the Madonie hills near Cefalù
homes.title_es: Casa urbana de cuatro niveles lista para vivir en Collesano, en las colinas de Madonie cerca de Cefalù
homes.summary: A terraced house on four levels in the centre of Collesano, a town inside the Madonie Park near Cefalù. The advert describes it as bright, in excellent condition and ready to live in at once. Two big storerooms with two toilets on the ground floor, two large rooms and a bathroom on the first, a bedroom, a master bedroom and a bathroom on the second, and on top a kitchen and living room under timber ceilings with a balcony facing the mountains. The agent gives about 220 m² in the text and 200 m² in the details. Asking €115,000, under €600/m².

homes.title: Renovated one-bedroom country house on 4,000 m² of land near Francavilla Fontana, Puglia
homes.title_es: Casa de campo renovada de un dormitorio en 4.000 m² de terreno cerca de Francavilla Fontana, Puglia
homes.summary: A single-storey country house of about 85 m² on 4,000 m² of gated private land with olive trees, around 10 minutes from Francavilla Fontana. The inside has been redone in a modern style: an open living room with a fitted kitchen and breakfast bar, a double bedroom, a tiled shower room with washer and dryer, air conditioning and a wood stove. Outside there are gravel terraces, a hammock under the trees and a sun-lounger corner. The owner puts Brindisi airport 25 to 30 minutes away, with both the Adriatic and Ionian coasts in easy reach. Private sale. Asking €139,000.

homes.title: Hillside house with a sea-view veranda 1 km from Porto Ottiolu beach
homes.title_es: Casa en la colina con veranda y vistas al mar a 1 km de la playa de Porto Ottiolu
homes.summary: A two-level terraced house in the peaceful hillside hamlet of Ludduì, Budoni, with an exclusive view of the Sardinian sea: a bright living room with an open kitchen and a spiral staircase, opening onto a covered veranda for dining with the sea on the horizon; upstairs, a master bedroom with its own courtyard, a second bedroom and a bathroom. 1 km from the golden beach and marina of Porto Ottiolu and 2.5 km from Budoni. Asking €158,000, about €2,469/m².

homes.title: Panoramic terraces and a private garden in a historic Lunigiana village
homes.title_es: Terrazas panorámicas y jardín privado en un pueblo histórico de Lunigiana
homes.summary: Tucked into one of Italy's most beautiful historic villages in the Lunigiana, this characterful home combines panoramic terraces and a rare private garden with wonderful views across the countryside.

homes.title: Stylish renovated flat with a fireplace and terrace in Montaione, Tuscany
homes.title_es: Piso reformado con estilo, chimenea y terraza en Montaione, Toscana
homes.summary: A three-room first-floor home with a fully independent entrance in the quiet Mura area of Montaione, carefully renovated in 2019: a spacious living room with a fireplace opening onto a private terrace, a modern kitchen with a wooden table and pendant lights, two bright bedrooms and a bathroom with a window. Below, a private courtyard and a cellar with a laundry corner. In the hills between Florence, Pisa and Siena. Asking €140,000, about €1,795/m².

homes.title: Detached town house with three en-suite bedrooms in old Iglesias, Sardinia
homes.title_es: Casa adosada independiente con tres dormitorios en suite en la Iglesias antigua, Cerdeña
homes.summary: A detached house in the historic centre of Iglesias in south-west Sardinia, about 15 minutes by car from the Sulcis coast and the beach at Masua, according to the advert. About 104 m2 with three double bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, plus a living room and kitchenette. The owner lists new windows and doors, heat pumps for heating and cooling, carpenter-made furniture and a wrought-iron staircase. Sold fully furnished and equipped, ready to move in. Light from two street fronts. Listed by the owner.

homes.title: Restored 14th-century stone house with two terraces in Rocchetta di Fazio, Tuscany
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra restaurada del siglo XIV con dos terrazas en Rocchetta di Fazio, Toscana
homes.summary: A 14th-century stone house at the edge of the hill village of Rocchetta di Fazio, free on three sides, with a wide view over the woods towards Monte Argentario. It was restored about 20 years ago with a new roof and ceilings, keeping the chestnut beams and handmade terracotta floors, and the advert says it was made earthquake-proof. About 118 m² on two levels with two bathrooms, two terraces and a garden of about 300 m². It is sold fully furnished. There is one bedroom now, and the agent suggests the kitchen could become a second. Shops are about five minutes away. Asking €160,000.

homes.title: Stone country house with a garden and three bathrooms near Chiusi della Verna, Tuscany
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de piedra con jardín y tres baños cerca de Chiusi della Verna, Toscana
homes.summary: A solid stone house of about 145 m² on three floors, listed in good structural condition. The ground floor has a large beamed living room with a fireplace and a kitchen corner, plus a bathroom. Upstairs are two bedrooms and two more bathrooms. The lower floor has two extra rooms with windows and their own outside door, useful as a studio or workshop. A separate woodshed and a lawned garden come with it. The bright, clean photos show tidy terracotta floors and wooden ceilings. Asking €165,000, about €1,140 per m².

homes.title: Ground-floor flat with a 225 m2 south-facing garden in Savignone, Liguria
homes.title_es: Piso de planta baja con jardín orientado al sur de 225 m² en Savignone, Liguria
homes.summary: A private sale of a 75 m2 flat with its own entrance in a nine-unit building in Savignone, a green village in the hills behind Genoa, 600 m from the main square. The best part is a south-facing garden of 225 m2 with a vine pergola and mountain views, plus a covered 14 m2 veranda. Inside are a large living room, a kitchenette, a double bedroom, a bathroom and a second room for a bedroom or study. Described as in excellent condition, with its own heating, and mostly furnished. The seller says management fees are low but gives no figure.

homes.title: Restored brick house with courtyard in the old centre of Amandola, Le Marche
homes.title_es: Casa de ladrillo restaurada con patio en el centro antiguo de Amandola, Le Marche
homes.summary: An independent brick house in the historic centre of Amandola, at the foot of the Sibillini mountains, fully restored with an anti-seismic structure according to the advert. About 85 m2 over four levels: a living and dining room with kitchenette and a shower room on the entry floor, two double bedrooms and a second bathroom above, an attic used as a studio and a cellar with a cave cut into the rock. It has a small private courtyard, double glazing and radiators on town gas. The upper floor has its own street door. Energy class G.

homes.title: Detached stone house with garden and valley views near Cascia, Umbria
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra independiente con jardín y vistas al valle cerca de Cascia, Umbría
homes.summary: A detached stone house built in 2006, so it has the look of an old Umbrian cottage without the old-house problems. It stands at the edge of the hamlet of Colforcella, about 3 km from Cascia, on roughly 600 m2 of its own land with open views over the valley and hills. Inside are about 84 m2 on two floors: two living areas with fireplaces, a fitted kitchen, one double bedroom and two bathrooms, with beams and terracotta floors. Gas heating, private parking and a small store. Sold fully furnished by the owner and described as ready to use.

homes.title: Stone farmhouse with four bedrooms and 3 hectares of land near Gubbio, Umbria
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de granja con cuatro dormitorios y 3 hectáreas de terreno cerca de Gubbio, Umbría
homes.summary: A seismically reinforced stone farmhouse portion in a sunny, secluded spot 20 minutes from medieval Gubbio, with its own entrance and about 3 hectares of land. The 110 m2 first floor holds a large kitchen, a living room with a fireplace, four double bedrooms and two bathrooms. Below are another 110 m2 of storerooms that could become a second flat. There is also a barn with a wood-fired oven and a tool shed. The photos show a clean stone exterior and plain, tidy rooms. At 148,000 euros this is a lot of house and land for central Italy.

homes.title: House in Ventimiglia di Sicilia, Palermo
homes.title_es: Casa en Ventimiglia di Sicilia, Palermo
homes.summary: €729/m² · 48 m² · 3 rooms. Ventimiglia di Sicilia (PA) - in the Traversa district, within the "Villaggio la Madonnina" residential complex, RE/MAX offers for sale a fully furnished villa of approximately 50 sqm, composed as…

homes.title: Three-floor village home with a panoramic balcony over the rooftops
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de tres plantas con balcón panorámico sobre los tejados
homes.summary: Spread across three cozy floors, this characterful Italian home offers two bedrooms and a panoramic balcony overlooking the surrounding countryside and village rooftops. With everyday essentials just a short walk away, it is an inviting little base for experiencing the slower rhythm of Italian village life.

homes.title: Historic hilltop home with medieval cellars, terraces and valley views
homes.title_es: Casa histórica en lo alto de una colina con bodegas medievales, terrazas y vistas al valle
homes.summary: Nestled in a charming hilltop village, this character-filled Tuscan home blends centuries of history with breathtaking views across the surrounding valley.

homes.title: Renovated village home with sea views below the castle in Rosignano Marittimo, Tuscany
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo renovada con vistas al mar bajo el castillo en Rosignano Marittimo, Toscana
homes.summary: A recently renovated home of 58 m² in the medieval centre of Rosignano Marittimo, at the foot of the castle, with its own street door and windows on all four sides. Beamed ceilings, an open living room with a fitted kitchen that is included in the price, a double bedroom with a storage mezzanine and a large shower room. Several windows look across the rooftops to the Tyrrhenian Sea. Heat pump for heating and cooling, new double-glazed windows, residents' parking a short walk away. Ready to move into. Asking €125,000. The advert states there are no condominium fees.

homes.title: Sea-view flat with two balconies near the Aregai marina in Cipressa, Liguria
homes.title_es: Piso con vistas al mar y dos balcones cerca de la marina de Aregai en Cipressa, Liguria
homes.summary: A second-floor flat of about 73 m2 in a small three-storey building with shared gardens near the port of Aregai, on the western Ligurian coast. The advert places it a short walk from the beaches and the coastal cycle path, and the photos show open sea from the balconies. Hall, bright living room with kitchen, double bedroom, bathroom and a store cupboard, with a balcony off both main rooms. A cellar and an outdoor parking space are included. There is no heating installed, only the pipework for radiators, so budget for that. Condominium fees about 700 euros a year.

homes.title: Renovated village flat with a large sea-view terrace in Pairola, Liguria
homes.title_es: Piso de pueblo renovado con gran terraza con vistas al mar en Pairola, Liguria
homes.place: Pairola, San Bartolomeo al Mare (Imperia, Liguria)
homes.summary: A top-floor flat of about 80 m² in a period building in Pairola, a quiet olive-grove village less than 3 km above San Bartolomeo al Mare and its beaches. It was fully renovated, keeping the slate stairs and wooden beams. There is a large living room with a kitchenette, a bedroom, a mezzanine used as a second bedroom, two bathrooms, a small balcony and a big private terrace looking over the church tower to the sea. It gets sun on three sides. The photos show it clean and furnished. Asking €175,000, about €2,190 per m².

homes.title: Newly renovated two-bed flat with sea-view terrace in Castellaro, Liguria
homes.title_es: Piso de dos dormitorios recientemente renovado con terraza con vista al mar en Castellaro, Liguria
homes.summary: A two-bedroom flat of about 76 m2 in a small building 300 metres from the hill village of Castellaro, freshly renovated and ready to move into, with no condominium fees. The terrace has wide views over olive groves to the sea, which also shows from the bedroom windows. Inside are a living room with a new kitchen, a main bedroom with walk-in wardrobe and en suite, a second bathroom and a laundry area. Heating and cooling come from inverter units, with double glazing and electric shutters. A 43 m2 garage below can be bought separately. Asking 197,000 euros.

homes.title: Tuscan cottage with an olive-tree garden 5 minutes from Saturnia hot springs
homes.title_es: Casita toscana con jardín de olivos a 5 minutos de las termas de Saturnia
homes.summary: An independent house with a corner garden and a beautiful olive tree in Montemerano, one of the Most Beautiful Villages in Italy, in the hills of the Tuscan Maremma: a living room with a kitchenette, two well-kept bedrooms with spectacular views and a bathroom, plus a 24 m² garage underneath. Panoramic position and its own entrance; the famous Saturnia hot springs are just 5 minutes by car. Price recently reduced. Asking €139,000, about €1,829/m².

homes.title: Vaulted stone home with terrace in Cisternino's old town
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra abovedada con terraza en el casco antiguo de Cisternino
homes.summary: In the white historic centre of Cisternino, Puglia: about 45 m² under stone vaults with an entrance hall, living room with sofa bed, kitchenette and bathroom, and a staircase up to the bedroom level and a private terrace. Furnished and ready to use.

homes.title: Whitewashed stone house in Locorotondo, Puglia, ready to move into
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra encalada en Locorotondo (Apulia), lista para entrar
homes.summary: A typical detached 'cummersa' of about 45 m² on Via Porta Nuova in the historic centre of Locorotondo, one of Italy's most beautiful villages in the Itria Valley. Ready to move into and in excellent structural condition: living area and guest bathroom below, a bedroom with a period fireplace above. Works as a home or a holiday let.

homes.title: Three-bedroom hilltop home with two fireplaces and a panoramic mountain terrace
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios en la cima de una colina con dos chimeneas y una terraza panorámica de montaña
homes.summary: Set in a peaceful hilltop village in Liguria, this bright home pairs generous living spaces, two fireplaces and a panoramic terrace with beautiful views across the surrounding mountains. With three spacious bedrooms and a move-in-ready interior, it is a welcoming place to enjoy authentic Tuscan village life.

homes.title: Restored medieval hamlet home with two en-suite bedrooms near Spoleto, Umbria
homes.title_es: Casa de aldea medieval restaurada con dos dormitorios en suite cerca de Spoleto, Umbría
homes.summary: A recently renovated house on three levels with its own entrance, in a small medieval hamlet 5 km from Spoleto. The ground floor is a living room with kitchen, and each upper floor has a bedroom with a fireplace and its own bathroom. Finishes are modern resin floors set against vaulted ceilings and rough stone-effect walls, and the advert calls the condition perfect. With it come a 5 m2 laundry, an 11 m2 room with bathroom that still needs work, and two small plots of 126 and 63 m2. The commercial area is 73 m2. Asking 155,000 euros.

homes.title: House with garden in Borgorose, Rieti
homes.title_es: Casa con jardín en Borgorose, Rieti
homes.summary: €690/m² · 71 m² · 3 rooms. Your haven of peace between history and nature: just an hour from Rome, in the authentic charm of Poggiovalle.

homes.title: Little stone farmhouse with terrace in an Umbrian village
homes.title_es: Pequeña casa de labranza de piedra con terraza en un pueblo de Umbría
homes.summary: 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, 40 m² (431 sq ft). One bedroom, one charming village and all the ingredients for a slower pace. This little stone farmhouse keeps things simple, with a warm living room, a practical kitchen, a cozy open dining space and a terraced area for enjoying the fresh air.

homes.title: 3-bed stone village house in a quiet hamlet
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de piedra de 3 dormitorios en una aldea tranquila
homes.summary: Stone village house in a small quiet hamlet This charming 3-bedroom village house sits in a quiet little hamlet surrounded by idyllic countryside, with warm country character that feels perfectly at home in the setting.
